Referral program

Value even after the sale closes

Real estate agencies and independent agents can earn a reward for referring a suitable owner or client into the program. Cooperation terms and rewards are set out in a separate partnership agreement, individually per situation.

FAQ

What you should know

How does the referral reward work?

You receive a reward, per an individual partnership agreement, for a referred client or property that successfully joins the program.

Do I need to sell the property through you to refer a client?

No. The client or property just needs to fit the fixed rent program's criteria — the sale itself can happen anywhere.

What if the client already owns the property?

That's fine too — we assess the property regardless of where or when it was purchased.

When do I receive the reward?

After the contract between the owner and our operating company is signed, per the terms of the partnership agreement.

Do we need a long-term contract to refer clients?

No, cooperation can be occasional — we sign a partnership agreement for clear reward terms, not to commit you to regular referrals.
